## What and why

<!-- The change, and the issue or spec requirement it serves (REQ-00N-PRS-…). -->

## Checklist

- [ ] The spec changed first, where behaviour, a business term or the API changes
- [ ] Tests first, where a spec's Definition of Done describes the behaviour: failing tests committed before the code
- [ ] Official files never edited, only replaced from their source; a difference in them recorded in a test, with its reason
- [ ] Guides, the architecture and ADRs updated, where they describe what changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md`'s "Unreleased" names the change, where a caller notices it
- [ ] No real invoices, company data or secrets in code, tests, docs or commit messages
